name: sand
notes: Rippled sand: a narrow ring at 10 c/dia confined to an 18-degree wedge. The ring fixes one ripple wavelength, the wedge deletes every orientation but one, and random phase supplies the dislocations and Y-junctions a real ripple field has without any of it being modelled. Rides the DEEP scattered train (dual scatter 0.7, spacing 0.07, n=12): a stationary Gaussian field averages to the same field, so it can spend the overlap that buys full scatter (docs/spectral-atlas.md §4). tonal.gain 3 restores the log-contrast that averaging costs; tonal.floor 0.02 stops one stamp's field minimum punching a full-ink speck through the stack. From the spectral sweep in docs/spectral-atlas.md; levels 30/55/80 are damage DEPTH, not coverage - moderate damage renders as moderate contrast over intact paint. Verified by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs.
